answer: Proof of Humanity makes each extra identity pay one filmed video, one vouch from a verified member, and about $100 in ETH locked at submission; a farm running N fakes pays N×$100 and cannot share it because one face on video belongs to one living person and the soulbound ID is non-transferable. A farm reusing one actor dies by duplicate challenge at 2: the second video is refused, both payments are lost, and the seat is void. The registry stands on basalt, each profile a marble record, and the bridge to a Kleros jury settles every dispute.
